address: 72, Lane 247, Section 1, Zhongshan North Road, Tamsui District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Behind sky blue doors, the dining rooms exude retro chic thanks to vintage furniture and assorted memorabilia. After training formally, the chef honed his skills for over three decades before opening Woogu House. He offers two omakase-style menus, creatively blending a healthy eating philosophy with Taiwanese culinary traditions. His sea bass in red wine lees sauce is served with seasonal greens, creating a unique ensemble of colours and flavours.
